release_notes:
Vortex PT v1.1.0:
• RAM Concept Profile Fidelity: Profile elevations and reverse parabolic geometry strictly preserve native RAM Concept design values (e.g. 230mm high points, 300mm cantilever/anchor profiles) in cross-section viewer without erroneous intermediate clamping or shifts.
• Edge Beam Formwork Deduction Separation: When anchors terminate in deep edge beams (e.g. 450mm beam on 300mm slab), the formwork drop deduction (150mm) is applied exclusively to the shop drawing text label (CL 150*) and fabrication chair tables, while the tendon trajectory curve and cross-section viewer retain the true 300mm structural profile.
• ADAPT-Builder Cantilever Profile Resolution: Corrected cantilever profile inflection detection (cantilever down vs cantilever up) to preserve smooth downward tendon profiles to end anchors.
